subject: joule v0.1.8 release — native OS GUI installers
opening: v0.1.8 ships real native installers: Windows Setup.exe, macOS .pkg/.dmg with joule.app, and Linux .deb — not tarball-only.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: Users double-click platform installers. CLI one-liners remain. Unsigned until Authenticode/Apple notarization certs exist; SmartScreen/Gatekeeper may warn.
